summary: Support ROV inspection and marine survey projects by assisting in processing and organising visual and sonar data, preparing accurate technical reports, maintaining project records, and supporting technical and sales teams with documentation.
responsibilities: Assist in reviewing and organising ROV inspection videos and images.
Support processing of SONAR data (imaging sonar, profiling sonar, etc.) under guidance.
Perform basic data checks to ensure completeness and quality.
Organise and archive project data in a structured manner.
required_skills: Familiarity with MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Willingness to learn data processing and reporting tools used in marine surveys.
Basic computer and file management skills.
Ability to follow instructions and meet deadlines.
nice_to_have_skills: Data processing and reporting tools used in marine surveys (e.g. ArcGIS, ERDAS Imagine).
Programming languages such as Python or R.
education_level: Diploma / BE / BTech , Civil Computer Applications (BCA)
